seo.description: Private journeys and small-group departures through New Zealand, designed and hosted by their founders, two women from Barcelona who call the country home. 4- and 5-star hotels and private experiences.

hero.etiqueta: Bespoke journeys · New Zealand, from within
hero.sub: The world's most dreamed-of destination, lived the way only those who call it home can live it. Private journeys and grand small-group journeys, designed and hosted by our founders.

pais.titulo: Some places you visit. Others change you forever.
pais.p1: New Zealand was one of the last lands on Earth to be reached by people, and you can still feel it. Here, fiords open to the sea between waterfalls that fall from the clouds, volcanoes breathe beneath your feet and the forests keep the song of birds found nowhere else on the planet.
pais.p2: Glaciers, wild beaches, lakes of an impossible turquoise and skies so pure that, at night, the stars feel within reach.
pais.cierre: Not just another journey. The journey.
pais.pie: Aoraki / Mount Cook above Lake Pukaki, Canterbury

cita.texto: “New Zealand was our dream. Today it is our home.”
cita.firma: Sylvie and Mónica · Founders of WatchOut Tours

privado.titulo: Your New Zealand, designed for you alone.
privado.texto: An anniversary, a family celebration, that promise you made each other years ago. We design your journey from scratch, on the dates you choose, with every route, hotel and experience hand-picked by our founders.
privado.modo1Texto: Sylvie and Mónica travel with you throughout, opening doors you won't find in any guidebook.
privado.modo2Texto: You take the wheel; we take care of every detail. We book absolutely everything and support you before, during and after your journey.

sesenta.texto: A lifetime dreaming of this journey. Now it's time to live it as you deserve: grand routes from north to south in a very small group, at a gentle pace, with private experiences, 4- and 5-star hotels and two hosts looking after every detail, from the first embrace to the final toast.

ciegos.texto: Aotearoa through the senses: journeys for blind and low-vision travellers, designed to feel New Zealand with your whole body. The warmth of volcanic earth beneath your hands, the roar of a fiord, the wind of the Alps on your face.

salida.texto: Fifteen days from north to south, from the geothermal valleys of Rotorua to the fiords of Milford Sound and the waters of Kaikōura, where sperm whales surface before snow-capped peaks. Departure from Spain on 27 February. Very limited places.
salida.aviso: Would you like to travel with us in a group? Our next departure is The Grand Journey, 1 – 15 March 2027.

items.texto: Doors that don't open to the ordinary traveller: private experiences, encounters with the guardians of Māori culture and places you won't find in any guidebook.
Sylvie and Mónica welcome you to their country the way one welcomes guests at home: with knowledge, judgement and a level of care that is never delegated.
Every journey is designed from scratch, hotel by hotel and experience by experience. Never a package: always a one-of-a-kind creation.
We travel by the Tiaki Promise: deep respect for the land, its culture and its people.

tiaki.titulo:
We love this country.
That is why we care for it.
tiaki.texto: Tiaki means to care, in te reo Māori. It is the promise New Zealand asks of everyone who travels here, and we have made it our own: to journey through this land as you would enter someone else's home, with respect, with gratitude and with the commitment to leave it as we found it for those who come after us.

items.titulo: Care for land, sea and nature
items.texto: We tread lightly and leave no trace. We travel in very small groups and choose experiences that respect wildlife and protected places.
We know every road and every season. We plan with care and with respect for the people who live in each place we visit.
We approach Māori culture alongside its hosts, with an open heart and mind. We listen before we look.

tiaki.cierre: Every journey we design is also a way of giving thanks to the land that welcomed us.

items.texto: Geysers that break the silence, boiling mud and the most vibrant Māori culture in the country.
Glaciers that break into icebergs on lakes of turquoise.

items.titulo: The adventure capital of the world.
items.texto: Mountains, lakes and vineyards: leap into the void, or raise a glass beside Lake Wakatipu.

items.titulo: Where the mountains meet the sea.
items.texto: Sperm whales, dolphins and seals in the wild, with the snowy Alps as a backdrop.
Thousands of glowworms silently light the caves like a starry sky.

fundadoras.titulo: We fell in love with a country. And we stayed.
fundadoras.p1: More than eight years ago, we left Barcelona to follow a dream. We had travelled half the world, yet no place had ever made us feel what we felt when we arrived here. New Zealand didn't just win us over: it changed our lives.
fundadoras.p2: Sylvie has managed hotels in New Zealand and has mastered the art of hospitality like few others. Mónica, a tireless traveller and coach specialising in NLP, has a gift for turning a journey into an experience that transforms you from within.
fundadoras.p3: Eight years on, this country still moves us every morning when we wake up. WatchOut Tours was born to share that feeling: we have travelled every route, chosen every hotel and lived every experience before you.

resenas.etiqueta: What you feel, you never forget

cierre.texto: Tell us how you dream of it, and we'll begin designing it.

pie.frase: Bespoke journeys through New Zealand, designed and hosted by our founders.

items.a: Accommodation in 4 and 5-star hotels, breakfast and dinner every day, every activity on the itinerary, transport along the whole route, the inter-island flight, two guides for the whole trip and 24-hour assistance. It doesn’t include international flights (we’ll help you book them) or travel insurance.

items.q: What if the group doesn’t fill up?
items.a: If the group is smaller when bookings close, we’ll offer you the choice of travelling anyway with a supplement or a full refund of everything you’ve paid. It’s up to you.

items.q: How do I book and pay?
items.a: We’ll send you all the booking and payment conditions with the itinerary, and go through them calmly with you on the video call.
Yes, it’s compulsory, with medical and cancellation cover. We’ll help you choose one.

items.q: How fit do I need to be?
items.a: There are walks almost every day, most of them short and on easy ground, and the odd day with a longer walk. We’ll talk it through before you book, so you can feel at ease.

items.q: Can I travel on my own?
items.a: Yes. You can have a single room with a supplement, or share with another member of the group who’s also travelling on their own.

items.q: What if I don’t speak English?
items.a: You don’t need to: the whole trip is in Spanish, with us.

portada.etiqueta: Beyond Sight · Aotearoa through the senses
portada.sub: Journeys through New Zealand for blind and low-vision travellers, designed to be felt with your whole body. Everything included, everything prepared, and us by your side around the clock.

manifiesto.titulo:
New Zealand is lived through your hands,
your ears and your skin.
manifiesto.p1: New Zealand is on the other side of the world, but it has never been out of your reach.
manifiesto.p2: The icy spray of a waterfall on your face at Milford Sound. The warmth of Rotorua's volcanic earth beneath your feet. Your hands tracing a Māori carving, groove by groove. Stepping through the round door of Bag End and into the Shire like a true hobbit.
manifiesto.cierre: Because New Zealand isn't something you look at: it's something you feel.

items.texto: Mountains, fiords and iconic places you can explore with your hands to understand the landscape before you live it.
We've done every activity before you, so every experience is safe, accessible and truly thrilling.
We describe every place with detail and care: the light, the colours, the shapes and everything happening around you.
Sylvie and Mónica are your hosts and guides throughout the journey, day and night. You won't have to take care of a thing.

incluye.titulo:
All you have to do
is live it.

items.texto: Chosen for their comfort, location and accessibility, with an orientation of every room on arrival.
Every morning and every evening, served at the table. No buffets, no trays and no need to ask for help.
We travel the country in our own vehicle, just for the group, with the domestic flight between the two islands included.
Booked, paid for and adapted before you arrive.
We're waiting for you when you land and stay with you until your flight home.
Before, during and after the journey. Your family can rest easy.

explorar.sub: Every route brings together adrenaline, the senses and Māori culture. The only limits are the ones you set.

items.texto: Paragliding over Queenstown, kayaking among seals in Kaikōura, jet boats along the rivers. As far as you want to go.
Touch, smell and hearing open up every place: the Shire, Rotorua's geothermal valleys, the fiords of Milford Sound.
The moko, the hāngi and the song of the whales through the hydrophone in Kaikōura.

explorar.pie: The hāngi, the moko, the haka: Māori culture is lived up close, never from a distance.

reel.etiqueta: This is how the adventure feels
reel.titulo:
Who said flying
was only for the few?
reel.p1: At WatchOut Tours we believe adventure knows no limits. It knows curiosity, emotion and people eager to live something they'll remember for the rest of their lives.
reel.p2: This is one of our travellers flying over Queenstown. The wind on your face, the sense of freedom and that mix of nerves and excitement right before take-off… some moments stay with you forever.
reel.videoAria: Video: one of our blind travellers takes off paragliding over Queenstown. He runs towards the edge of the slope, jumps and feels the thrill of touching the sky for the first time.

audios.titulo: This is how New Zealand sounds.

grupo.texto: Just a few travellers who share your eagerness to discover the world, with everything included: 4- and 5-star hotels, plated breakfasts and dinners, every activity and us by your side around the clock. Some journeys end; others give you friendships for life.

privado.etiqueta: Just for you and yours, on your dates
privado.texto: We design it with you: your days, your energy, your time. More calm? More calm. More adrenaline? More adrenaline. With the same attention to every sense, and our founders as your hosts from start to finish.

resena.etiqueta: What you feel, you never forget

cierre.texto: A journey like this raises many questions, and we love answering them. Tell us what excites you and together we'll find the best way to experience it.

portada.titulo:
That journey you've been promising
yourself for years.
portada.sub: New Zealand in a small group of like-minded travellers, with everything included and every detail taken care of: 4- and 5-star hotels, breakfast and dinner every day, a private luxury vehicle and two hosts by your side from start to finish.

paraQuien.cita: “For anyone who has always dreamed of the other side of the world. And whose moment has finally come.”
paraQuien.p1: For anyone who never found the right moment, the right company or someone to make it easy. For couples who finally have the time, for friends who have been saying "one day" for years, and for solo travellers who'd like to come home with new friends.
paraQuien.p2: Here you won't have to think about language, luggage, timetables or where to have dinner. We take care of all of that.

incluye.titulo:
All you have to do
is let yourself be carried away.

items.texto: Each one chosen for its location, its comfort and its charm.
Every morning and every evening, the table is set. No searching for restaurants, no thinking about reservations.
We travel the country in our own vehicle, comfortable and just for the group. The domestic flight between the two islands is included too.
The journey's great experiences are already booked and paid for, many of them private for the group.
Sylvie and Mónica welcome you at the airport, travel with you every day and guide you in Spanish through every place.
Before, during and after the journey, there's always someone on the other end. Your family can rest easy.

experiencias.titulo:
Moments you can't
book on your own.

items.titulo: The Shire, just for the group
items.texto: We explore Hobbiton with a private guide, step inside a real hobbit hole and finish with lunch served at the Green Dragon Inn.
A full day among geysers, boiling mud and Māori culture told from within, with a traditional welcome and a Māori-inspired lunch.

items.titulo: Kaikōura, face to face with sperm whales
items.texto: From the captain's cabin, with front-row seats and panoramic windows, we wait for the giant of the ocean to surface against snow-capped mountains.

solo.texto: Many of our travellers arrive on their own and, within a couple of days, they're part of the group. You can have your own room or, if you prefer, share with another solo traveller in the group.

anfitrionas.texto: Sylvie and Mónica have lived in New Zealand for more than eight years. Sylvie has managed hotels in the country and knows like few others what it means to look after a guest. Mónica has a gift for making a group of strangers feel like family from day one. Together, they anticipate every detail so all you have to do is enjoy it.

llevaras.title: What you’ll take home
llevaras.p: Steam from the geysers on your skin. Whale song through a hydrophone in Kaikōura. The stars of Tekapo, told around a campfire. The taste of hāngi, cooked underground on volcanic stones.

items.alt: Hobbiton, Matamata: hobbit holes set among green hills
Seven travellers and guides gather on a boardwalk with steam from the Pōhutu Geyser rising behind them
Milford Sound: sheer rock walls rising straight out of the fiord
Lake Tekapo’s turquoise water with mountains behind
Two travellers sitting in a yellow kayak on the waters of Kaikōura, wearing Seal Kayak Kaikoura life jackets, looking towards another kayak with more travellers under a clear sky

items.q: Do I need to be fit?
items.a: Not at all. There are short walks most days, always at your own pace and with time to enjoy every place. If you have any questions, just call us and we'll talk it through.

items.q: What if I don't speak English?
items.a: You don't need to. We travel with you and translate everything, at every activity and every moment.
International flights, travel insurance (compulsory) and a few free lunches so you can explore at your own pace. Everything else is.

items.q: What if I'd like a little more excitement?
items.a: We can arrange it as an optional extra: a helicopter flight over the glacier, a jet boat ride in Queenstown and much more.

Your New Zealand,
designed for you alone.
portada.sub: A journey that doesn't exist until you imagine it. We design it from scratch, on your dates and to your measure, with every route, hotel and experience hand-picked by our founders.

manifiesto.cita: “We don't adapt packages. We create journeys only you could live.”
manifiesto.texto: An anniversary, a family celebration, that promise you made each other years ago. Every private journey begins with a conversation about what you dream of and ends with a route designed down to the last detail: what to see, where to stay, what to feel in each place and at what pace to live it.

maneras.titulo: You choose how to live it.

items.texto: Sylvie and Mónica travel with you throughout the journey and open the doors of their country to you: the places you won't find in any guidebook, the people who give each place its meaning, and the peace of mind of having everything taken care of, with nothing to think about but enjoying it.

For those who dream of the freedom of the open road. You take the wheel; we take care of every detail: we design the route, book absolutely everything and support you remotely before, during and after your journey. The adventure is yours, and so is the peace of mind.

pasos.titulo: How your journey comes to life.

items.texto: Tell us what you dream of, when you'd like to travel and how you like to do it. By video call, at your own pace.
We create a proposal tailored to you, with the route, accommodation and experiences.
We refine it together until it's exactly the journey you imagined.
We book everything and look after you, in person or remotely, from start to finish.

items.q: How many days do I need to see New Zealand?
items.a: We recommend at least two weeks to explore both islands without rushing. Ten days lets you experience one island in depth. We'll talk it through based on what you'd like to see.

items.q: When is the best time to travel?
items.a: Every season has its charm: the southern summer (December to March) is ideal for nature and the coast; autumn for colour and tranquillity; winter for snow. We'll help you choose for your journey.
International flights aren't included, but we'll help you choose the best times and stopovers.
Of course. We design the journey with the whole family in mind, with pace and experiences for every age.

items.q: How much does a private journey cost?
items.a: It depends on the length, the season, the travel style and the type of accommodation. After our first conversation we'll send you a detailed proposal, with no obligation.

portada.titulo:
We fell in love with a country.
And we stayed.
portada.sub: We're Sylvie and Mónica. More than eight years ago we left Barcelona to follow a dream, and today we design and host journeys through the country that changed our lives.

historia.titulo:
From the other side of the world,
home.
parrafos: We had travelled half the world. We knew the thrill of arriving somewhere new and the ache of leaving it behind. But no journey had prepared us for what we felt when we landed in New Zealand.

It was the light. Fiords plunging into the sea between waterfalls, the earth breathing beneath your feet in Rotorua, skies so clear that at night the stars feel within reach. And it was the people, and a Māori culture that sees the land as something to care for, not something to own.
We came to discover it and never managed to leave. More than eight years have passed, and this country still moves us every morning when we wake up.
WatchOut Tours was born from a deep desire to share what we felt that first time. That's why we have travelled every route, chosen every hotel and lived every experience before you.

sylvie.texto: Sylvie has managed hotels in New Zealand and knows like few others what it means to look after a guest: anticipating what they need before they ask, taking care of every detail without it showing, and making them feel at home thousands of kilometres from their own. Hers is the eye that chooses every hotel and every table on our journeys.

monica.texto: Mónica is a tireless traveller and a coach specialising in NLP. She knows a journey can be far more than a route: it can be a before and an after. She has a gift for making a group of strangers feel like family from day one, and for turning every moment into something you'll remember for the rest of your life.

cita.texto: “New Zealand was our dream. Today it is our home. And nothing makes us happier than opening its doors to you.”

items.texto: Aoraki emerging from the clouds at the end of the valley. No matter how many times we see it, it always leaves us speechless.
The roar of a geyser, the scent of steam, the impossible colours of the hot springs. Here the earth is alive, and you can feel it.
The sea at Kaikōura, where dolphins swim alongside the bow and whales surface before the mountains. An ocean full of life.

cierre.texto: Tell us how you dream of your journey. We'll listen, by video call or in writing, and begin designing it together.
